snapshot.vvix_state: complacent (vol-of-vol cheap vs vol — historically precedes rising vol)
snapshot.doctrine: Index vol-regime: validated on 1990+ history, no dealer-sign assumption. Legs are SCORED only when the validation gate marks them earned; otherwise display/context. A regime read, not an intraday timer (delayed-EOD inputs).

sub.en: The vol surface is neither cheap-calm nor stressed. No regime edge either way — size to plan and let the levels below guide tactical entries.
sub.zh: 波动率曲面既不便宜平静、也未承压。两边都无体制优势 — 按计划定仓，用下方价位指导战术性入场。

bullets.en: Sizing: vol sits ABOVE the risk target — the vol-target scalar is 0.72× (trim gross to hold risk constant; this is the drawdown lever, not a forecast).
bullets.zh: 仓位：波动率高于风险目标 — 波动率目标系数为 0.72×（缩减总仓以保持风险恒定；这是回撤管理工具，而非预测）。

bullets.en: Hedging: downside protection is CHEAP (low SKEW percentile) — if you want tail insurance, convexity is on sale here.
bullets.zh: 对冲：下行保护便宜（SKEW百分位低）— 若需尾部保险，此处凸性折价。

bullets.en: Vol-of-vol: VVIX is CHEAP relative to VIX (complacency) — historically this has preceded RISING realized vol. A quiet-fragility tell (context, candidate).
bullets.zh: 波动率的波动率：VVIX 相对 VIX 偏便宜（自满）— 历史上往往先行于已实现波动率上升。属于平静下的脆弱性提示（参考，候选信号）。

opex.read: opex week: no statistically robust calendar edge measured (display context).
opex.doctrine: OPEX calendar seasonality — a thin, widely-known dealer-flow tilt measured on price history (no OI). Context only, never a buy/sell.

opex_risk.glance_en: Expiration week (quad-witching) — 0d to expiry. price may stick near big strikes, dealer books stretched, expiry-week exposure crowded. Dealer load rising — watch for sticky tape. Watch, don't chase. (3/3 signals active)
opex_risk.glance_zh: Expiration week (quad-witching) — 0d to expiry。价格或被大额行权价吸住，做市商持仓拉满，到期周敞口拥挤。经销商负载上升 — 注意粘性价格行为。观望，不追涨。（3/3项信号激活）
opex_risk.doctrine: OPEX window risk read — display/context only (RIC-R2/R3). Level = unweighted count of hot states (n_hot/n_applicable). Framing: vol/holdability/turn-WATCH only. NEVER read by compute(), never in _SCARES, never sizes or gates anything. Event/OPEX proximity states are display context, not risk elevations.
opex_risk.dealer_sign_passport: ASSUMPTION: net_vex/net_cex sign reflects the standard long-call+1/short-put+1 dealer convention (SqueezeMetrics / similar). This convention is structurally UNOBSERVABLE from public data. |·|-magnitude constructions are used where possible (concentration_hot, dealer_load_extreme) precisely because they are sign-agnostic. Any sign-dependent reading (vanna_hedge_5d, signed_vanna_pressure) carries this unobservable-assumption passport and must not be promoted to authority.
opex_risk.vanna_symmetry_caveat: VANNA SYMMETRY CAVEAT (RUL-OVC-1): vanna_relief (vol falling + positive vanna notional) has documented historical support for upside continuation in the index-ETF complex. The INVERSE state (vanna_drag: vol rising + positive vanna) is mechanically plausible but LESS WELL DOCUMENTED — it prints as a watch item, not an authority call. Both states are holdability/de-escalation reads only (RO-3). Neither is a directional buy or sell.
opex_risk.post_opex_watch: POST-OPEX WEAKNESS WATCH (Era3-only): The −0.9% post-OPEX-week return effect (Stivers-Sun 2013, 1988-2010) is ERA-SPLIT — it decayed post-2010 and the 'March worst' claim is WRONG (post-March-OPEX is actually among the stronger months per the RIC domain research pack). This watch item is printed honestly with its era-status: an accruing observation, not a durable signal. Framing: vol/path only, never directional return (RO-3/F-21).
